map.从法律文书中自动提取关键词，包括法律术语、日期、金额、当事人、法条引用等，辅助文: Automatically extracts keywords from legal documents, including legal terms, dates, amounts, parties and statutory citations, to assist document search and analysis.
map.📖 查看「法律关键词提取 使用指南」: 📖 View the guide to legal keyword extraction
map.：识别 yyyy年mm月dd日、yyyy-mm-dd 等格式。: : recognizes date formats such as yyyy-mm-dd, yyyy/mm/dd and yyyymmdd.
map.：识别「人民币XX元」「XX万元」「XX元」等金额表述。: : recognizes monetary expressions such as "CNY XX", "XX ten thousand CNY" and "XX CNY".
map.买卖合同判决书：粘贴文书后提取“原告张三”“被告李四”、日期 2024-03-1: Judgment on a sales contract: after pasting the document it extracts the plaintiff Zhang San and the defendant Li Si, the date 2024-03-15, the amount CNY 500,000, the statutory citations Article 577 and Article 585 of the Civil Code, and so on, helping to sort out the points in dispute quickly.
map.租赁合同纠纷：提取“租金”“押金”“违约”“解除”等高频法律术语，定位核心义务条: Lease contract dispute: extracts frequent legal terms such as rent, deposit, breach and termination to locate the core obligation clauses and the breach points.
map.批量文书检索：对多份文书统计高频词（频次 ≥2），辅助聚类、要点对比与类案检索。: Bulk document search: counts frequent words across several documents (frequency ≥ 2) to support clustering, comparison of key points and similar-case search.
map.算例：内置示例文书提取结果: Worked example: extraction results on the built-in sample document
map.默认示例为买卖合同纠纷判决书。工具识别到当事人“张三”“李四”、日期 2024-: The default sample is a judgment on a sales contract dispute. The tool identifies the parties Zhang San and Li Si, the dates 2024-03-15 and 2023-10-01 / 2023-12-31, the amounts CNY 500,000 and CNY 50,000, the statutory citations Article 577 and Article 585 of the Civil Code, and frequent words such as contract, breach and payment for goods; it outputs the total keyword count and displays them by category for easy search and archiving.
map.提取结果为何需要人工复核？: Why do the extraction results need manual review?
map.本工具基于规则与词典匹配，对复杂句式、同名歧义（如“王经理”）或非常见术语可能误: This tool works by rules and dictionary matching, so it may misjudge or miss complex sentence structures, ambiguous identical names (such as Manager Wang) or uncommon terms; verify key documents manually before relying on them.
map.文书内容会上传吗？: Will the document content be uploaded?
map.不会。所有识别在浏览器本地完成，文本不离开你的设备，不上传任何服务器，符合纯前端: No. All recognition happens locally in the browser; the text never leaves your device and is never uploaded to any server, in line with the pure front-end privacy principle.
map.粘贴法律文书内容，如判决书、合同、起诉状等...\n\n示例：\n原告张三与被告:
Paste the content of a legal document, such as a judgment, contract or complaint...

Example:
In the sales contract dispute between the plaintiff Zhang San and the defendant Li Si, this court registered the case on March 15, 2024. The plaintiff alleged that on October 1, 2023 the two parties signed a Purchase and Sale Contract under which the defendant would buy goods from the plaintiff for a total price of CNY 500,000. The defendant failed to pay for the goods on time, which constitutes a breach of contract. Pursuant to Article 577 of the Civil Code of the People’s Republic of China, the plaintiff requests a judgment ordering the defendant to pay CNY 500,000 for the goods plus CNY 50,000 in liquidated damages.
map.：识别《XX法》第X条等法条引用。: : recognizes statutory citations such as Article X of the Law on XX.
map.：统计文书中的高频实词（2字以上）。: : counts frequent content words in the document (2 characters or more).
map.：内置常见法律术语词典匹配，如违约、诉讼、判决、管辖等。: : matches against a built-in dictionary of common legal terms, such as breach, litigation, judgment and jurisdiction.
map.：识别「原告XX」「被告XX」「甲方XX」等主体称谓。: : recognizes designations of parties such as Plaintiff XX, Defendant XX and Party A XX.
